newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Philippine Presidential Adviser for Political Affairs Gabriel Claudio said President Fidel Ramos has given the go signal to House Speaker Jose de Venecia to call a caucus of members of his ruling party Lakas in the House of Representatives to determine when and how the Constitution will be amended. (INQUIRER)

- Government lawyers yesterday affirmed as legal the Commission on Elections' order to verify signatures gathered by a group pushing for an amendment of the Constitution on the term limits of elected officials. (MANILA BULLETIN)
